description: MBTI personality type descriptions - English version

ISTJ.title: The Inspector
ISTJ.description: ISTJs are practical, disciplined, and reliable. They focus on details, are responsible, and excel at organizing and systematizing work. They follow tradition and rules, valuing order and structure.
ISTJ.career_paths: Accountant, Project Manager, Systems Analyst, Quality Control Specialist, Auditor, and other roles requiring attention to detail and systematic approaches.
ISTJ.development_suggestions: Practice flexibility and adaptability, explore creative thinking methods, pay attention to others' emotional needs, and learn to appreciate different perspectives.

ISFJ.title: The Protector
ISFJ.description: ISFJs are thoughtful, loyal, and responsible. They quietly care for others' needs, pay attention to details, and create harmonious environments. They value tradition and security.
ISFJ.career_paths: Nurse, Teacher, HR Specialist, Social Worker, Administrative Assistant, and other caring, service-oriented roles.
ISFJ.development_suggestions: Learn to say 'no,' prioritize self-care, practice expressing your own needs, and be open to new ideas and changes.

INFJ.title: The Counselor
INFJ.description: INFJs are insightful, idealistic, and creative. They seek depth and meaning, care about others' growth, and can envision future possibilities. They stand by their values and beliefs.
INFJ.career_paths: Counselor, Psychologist, Writer, Teacher, Social Worker, and other roles focused on helping and understanding others.
INFJ.development_suggestions: Practice setting realistic expectations, take care of yourself while helping others, learn to accept imperfection, and develop practical implementation skills.

INTJ.title: The Mastermind
INTJ.description: INTJs are independent, strategic, and innovative. They excel at analyzing complex problems, making long-term plans, and continuously pursuing knowledge and improvement. They value efficiency and logic.
INTJ.career_paths: Engineer, Scientist, Strategic Consultant, Software Developer, Research Analyst, and other roles requiring strategic thinking and innovation.
INTJ.development_suggestions: Practice patience with others' learning pace, develop emotional intelligence, learn to appreciate team contributions, and balance perfectionism with practicality.

ISTP.title: The Craftsperson
ISTP.description: ISTPs are analytical, practical, and adaptable. They excel at solving immediate problems, enjoy hands-on work, and value independence and efficiency.
ISTP.career_paths: Mechanic, Engineer, IT Specialist, Pilot, Emergency Responder, and other technical, hands-on roles.
ISTP.development_suggestions: Develop long-term planning skills, practice expressing emotions, consider others' feelings in decision-making, and enhance communication abilities.

ISFP.title: The Composer
ISFP.description: ISFPs are gentle, creative, and harmonious. They value beauty and authenticity, live in the moment, and respect others' values and feelings.
ISFP.career_paths: Artist, Designer, Musician, Beautician, Counselor, and other roles involving creativity and aesthetics.
ISFP.development_suggestions: Develop assertiveness in expressing your needs, practice long-term planning, learn to handle criticism constructively, and enhance time management skills.

INFP.title: The Healer
INFP.description: INFPs are idealistic, creative, and empathetic. They seek meaning and authenticity, care about values and personal growth, and strive to help others realize their potential.
INFP.career_paths: Writer, Psychologist, Teacher, Artist, Social Worker, and other roles involving creativity and helping others.
INFP.development_suggestions: Practice setting realistic goals, develop decision-making confidence, learn to handle criticism, and balance idealism with practicality.

INTP.title: The Architect
INTP.description: INTPs are logical, analytical, and innovative. They seek to understand complex systems, enjoy theoretical exploration, and value intellectual precision and independence.
INTP.career_paths: Researcher, Programmer, Philosopher, Mathematician, Analyst, and other roles requiring deep thinking and problem-solving.
INTP.development_suggestions: Practice completing projects, develop social and communication skills, learn to consider emotional factors, and enhance time management abilities.

ESTP.title: The Dynamo
ESTP.description: ESTPs are energetic, practical, and adaptable. They enjoy action and adventure, excel in handling emergencies, and focus on immediate problems. They're social, pragmatic, and resourceful.
ESTP.career_paths: Entrepreneur, Sales Representative, Marketing Specialist, Emergency Responder, Sports Coach, and other action-oriented roles.
ESTP.development_suggestions: Develop patience for longer-term planning, practice listening to others completely before responding, consider long-term consequences, and enhance follow-through abilities.

ESFP.title: The Performer
ESFP.description: ESFPs are outgoing, friendly, and life-loving. They enjoy interacting with people, living in the moment, and bringing joy and energy to those around them. They're practical, adaptable, and experience-focused.
ESFP.career_paths: Event Planner, Sales Representative, Tour Guide, Entertainer, Customer Service Specialist, and other people-facing roles.
ESFP.development_suggestions: Develop patience for details and administrative tasks, practice long-term planning, enhance your ability to say 'no,' and consider long-term implications.

ENFP.title: The Champion
ENFP.description: ENFPs are enthusiastic, creative, and socially skilled. They see possibilities, excel at motivating others, and seek authenticity and growth. They're flexible, spontaneous, and innovation-focused.
ENFP.career_paths: Marketing Specialist, Counselor, Teacher, Writer, Journalist, Entrepreneur, and other creative, people-oriented roles.
ENFP.development_suggestions: Enhance focus and follow-through on projects, develop systems for time management, practice realistic planning, and learn to prioritize tasks.

ENTP.title: The Debater
ENTP.description: ENTPs are innovative, clever, and energetic. They enjoy intellectual challenges, excel at finding new solutions, and constantly question conventional thinking. They're adaptable and enjoy debates.
ENTP.career_paths: Entrepreneur, Consultant, Attorney, Inventor, Strategic Planner, and other roles requiring innovation and strategic thinking.
ENTP.development_suggestions: Practice follow-through on projects, develop sensitivity to others' feelings, learn to focus on one task at a time, and enhance attention to details.

ESTJ.title: The Supervisor
ESTJ.description: ESTJs are organized, practical, and decisive. They excel at managing, implementing plans, and maintaining order and efficiency. They value tradition, responsibility, and clear standards.
ESTJ.career_paths: Manager, Administrator, Military Officer, Financial Officer, Project Manager, and other leadership and management roles.
ESTJ.development_suggestions: Practice flexibility and openness to new ideas, develop empathy and emotional awareness, learn to delegate and trust others, and balance task focus with relationship building.

ESFJ.title: The Provider
ESFJ.description: ESFJs are warm, responsible, and cooperative. They care about others' needs, excel at creating harmony, and value tradition and social order. They're practical helpers and organizers.
ESFJ.career_paths: Teacher, Nurse, HR Manager, Event Coordinator, Office Manager, and other service and organization-oriented roles.
ESFJ.development_suggestions: Learn to prioritize your own needs, practice accepting criticism without taking it personally, develop comfort with conflict, and be open to change and new approaches.

ENFJ.title: The Teacher
ENFJ.description: ENFJs are charismatic, empathetic, and inspiring. They excel at understanding others, motivating people, and facilitating growth. They value harmony, authenticity, and positive impact.
ENFJ.career_paths: Teacher, Counselor, HR Developer, Public Relations Specialist, Sales Trainer, and other roles involving helping and developing others.
ENFJ.development_suggestions: Practice setting boundaries, take time for self-care, learn to accept criticism, and balance others' needs with your own.

ENTJ.title: The Commander
ENTJ.description: ENTJs are strategic, decisive, and natural leaders. They excel at long-term planning, organizing resources, and implementing efficient systems. They value competence, logic, and achievement.
ENTJ.career_paths: CEO, Executive, Business Strategist, Attorney, Military Commander, and other leadership and strategic roles.
ENTJ.development_suggestions: Practice patience with others' pace, develop emotional intelligence, learn to value process as much as results, and balance assertiveness with empathy.
